svg.title: Link Compressor (URL Shortener) — high level architecture
svg.desc: Clients call a public REST API backed by a Spring Boot service. The backend reads/writes PostgreSQL and Redis, publishes click events to Kafka for an asynchronous analytics pipeline, and exposes metrics to Prometheus and Grafana. Cross-cutting concerns, DevOps tooling, and API documentation are shown alongside. A request-flow strip at the bottom traces a single short-URL redirect end to end.
